title: Yatra’s ‘MICE’ Problem
summary: Bookings grew, but revenue shrank and profit disappeared. That was the paradox of Yatra in the September quarter, when India’s…
llm_summary: Yatra’s September‑quarter numbers show a classic “growth‑but‑no‑profit” paradox: while travel bookings rose, the company’s revenue actually fell and it ended the period with a net loss. The dip is tied to a sharp decline in its high‑margin MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) segment, which was hit by reduced corporate travel spending and lingering pandemic‑era caution.
